references.title: DiscoveryBench: Towards Data-Driven Discovery with Large Language Models
references.one_liner: 给出数据、背景和研究目标，让智能体提出并验证假设，而不只是写一段能运行的代码。
references.one_liner_en: Tests whether agents can develop and verify hypotheses from datasets, metadata and a research goal, beyond producing runnable code.
references.context: 从数据分析走向科学发现，适合比较研究过程与最终结论分别如何评分。
references.context_en: Useful for comparing evaluations of the discovery process with evaluations of the final claim.

references.title: ScienceWorld: Is your Agent Smarter than a 5th Grader?
references.one_liner: 让智能体在文字环境中动手做科学实验，检查它能否把记住的知识用在新情境里。
references.one_liner_en: Places agents in an interactive text world to test whether scientific knowledge transfers to hands-on experiments.
references.context: 交互式科学推理的早期基准；任务难度属于基础科学，不等同于真实科研。
references.context_en: An early interactive science benchmark; elementary experiments are distinct from professional research.

references.title: BenchGuard: Who Guards the Benchmarks? Automated Auditing of LLM Agent Benchmarks
references.one_liner: 交叉检查任务说明、数据和评分程序，寻找把合理答案判错、或让任务根本无法完成的基准缺陷。
references.one_liner_en: Cross-checks task specifications, data and scoring programs to find benchmark defects that reject valid solutions or make tasks unsolvable.
references.context: 评测基础设施的审计方法，用于区分智能体出错与基准本身出错。
references.context_en: An audit framework for distinguishing agent errors from errors in the benchmark itself.

references.title: MLAgentBench: Evaluating Language Agents on Machine Learning Experimentation
references.one_liner: 给智能体文件和执行环境，让它自己修改模型、运行实验，再根据结果继续改进。
references.one_liner_en: Gives agents files and an execution environment to modify models, run experiments and iterate on the results.
references.context: 机器学习实验任务的早期代表，可比较任务成功率与执行轨迹。
references.context_en: An early benchmark of machine learning experimentation, with task outcomes and execution traces.

references.title: MLE-bench: Evaluating Machine Learning Agents on Machine Learning Engineering
references.one_liner: 把 Kaggle 比赛变成机器学习工程任务，用公开的人类成绩衡量智能体训练和调试模型的水平。
references.one_liner_en: Turns Kaggle competitions into machine learning engineering tasks, using human competition results as a reference.
references.context: 适合研究工程能力、计算预算和训练数据污染对评测结果的影响。
references.context_en: Relevant to engineering ability, resource budgets and evaluation contamination.

references.title: CORE-Bench: Fostering the Credibility of Published Research Through a Computational Reproducibility Agent Benchmark
references.one_liner: 给出论文配套的代码和数据，检查智能体能否复现计算结果，并回答与结果相关的问题。
references.one_liner_en: Tests whether agents can reproduce computational results from published code and data and answer questions about them.
references.context: 这里的 CORE-Bench 指科研复现基准，并非同名的代码检索基准。
references.context_en: This is the computational reproducibility benchmark, distinct from the similarly named code-retrieval benchmark.

references.title: LAB-Bench: Measuring Capabilities of Language Models for Biology Research
references.one_liner: 把生物研究中的查文献、读图、查数据库和处理序列拆成具体能力，用选择题分别测试。
references.one_liner_en: Tests practical biology research skills, including literature reasoning, figure interpretation, database use and sequence manipulation.
references.context: 面向科研技能，但题目形式以选择题为主，不能直接等同于自主完成实验。
references.context_en: Measures research-related skills through multiple-choice questions, rather than autonomous experimental work.

references.title: BLADE: Benchmarking Language Model Agents for Data-Driven Science
references.one_liner: 同一研究问题允许不同分析路线；BLADE 用专家的多份分析作为参照，比较智能体做出的分析选择。
references.one_liner_en: Compares agents' analytical choices against multiple expert analyses of the same open-ended research questions.
references.context: 重点是开放分析和多种合理做法，比单一标准答案更贴近真实分析工作。
references.context_en: Especially relevant to open-ended analysis and the existence of multiple valid approaches.

references.title: DSBench: How Far Are Data Science Agents to Becoming Data Science Experts?
references.one_liner: 让智能体处理长背景、大数据文件和多张表，检验它能否完成更接近实际工作的分析与建模任务。
references.one_liner_en: Tests realistic analysis and modeling tasks involving long contexts, large files and multiple tables.
references.context: 适合比较简化问答与真实数据工作流之间的能力差距。
references.context_en: Useful for studying the gap between simplified questions and realistic data workflows.

references.title: InfiAgent-DABench: Evaluating Agents on Data Analysis Tasks
references.one_liner: 把 CSV 数据分析问题转成便于自动核对的回答格式，测试智能体与执行环境协作的能力。
references.one_liner_en: Evaluates data-analysis agents on CSV tasks using answer formats that support automatic scoring.
references.context: 可用来观察开放问题如何转为可评分答案，以及这种转换会限制哪些合理作答。
references.context_en: Shows how open analysis questions are converted into automatically scorable answers.

references.title: DataSciBench: An LLM Agent Benchmark for Data Science
references.one_liner: 把数据科学任务拆成任务、评价函数和执行代码，用更具体的规则检查生成程序的产出。
references.one_liner_en: Organizes data-science evaluation around tasks, functions and code, with explicit rules for checking execution outputs.
references.context: 重点看标答构建和评价规则，尤其是原本没有简单唯一答案的任务。
references.context_en: Relevant to ground-truth construction and metrics for tasks without a simple unique answer.

references.title: MLR-Bench: Evaluating AI Agents on Open-Ended Machine Learning Research
references.one_liner: 让智能体从研究想法一路做到实验和论文，既评估各阶段，也检查最终研究产物。
references.one_liner_en: Evaluates open-ended machine learning research from idea generation through experiments and paper writing.
references.context: 适合关注研究质量、自动评审与实验结果真实性之间的关系。
references.context_en: Useful for studying research quality, automated review and the validity of reported experiments.

references.title: PaperBench: Evaluating AI's Ability to Replicate AI Research
references.one_liner: 要求智能体从零复现研究论文，把复现目标拆成细致的评分项，检查理解、实现和实验执行。
references.one_liner_en: Asks agents to reproduce research papers from scratch, with detailed rubrics for understanding, implementation and experiments.
references.context: 与 CORE-Bench 互补：这里需要重新实现研究，而不只是运行作者已有的代码。
references.context_en: Complements CORE-Bench by requiring new implementations rather than only executing provided code.

references.title: SciCode: A Research Coding Benchmark Curated by Scientists
references.one_liner: 由科学家从真实研究问题中提炼编程任务，把科学知识、推理和代码实现放在一起测试。
references.one_liner_en: Uses scientist-curated coding problems to jointly test domain knowledge, reasoning and scientific programming.
references.context: 适合区分通用代码能力与需要科学背景的程序实现。
references.context_en: Helps distinguish general coding ability from programming that requires scientific knowledge.

references.title: BioCoder: A Benchmark for Bioinformatics Code Generation with Large Language Models
references.one_liner: 测试模型能否写出生物信息学代码，保留依赖、全局变量等上下文，并用模糊测试检查功能。
references.one_liner_en: Tests bioinformatics code generation with contextual dependencies and a fuzz-testing evaluation framework.
references.context: 这是领域代码生成基准，适合作为完整生物研究智能体的底层能力参照。
references.context_en: A domain-specific coding benchmark that provides a component-level reference for biology agents.

references.title: DSGym: A Holistic Framework for Evaluating and Training Data Science Agents
references.one_liner: 统一数据科学任务的执行和评价环境，过滤不看数据也能解答的捷径任务，并支持用执行反馈训练智能体。
references.one_liner_en: Standardizes execution and evaluation for data-science tasks, filters tasks solvable without their data, and supports training with execution feedback.
references.context: 重点看跨基准比较、数据依赖和任务质量，适合与具体数据分析基准一起阅读。
references.context_en: Relevant to cross-benchmark comparison, data grounding and task quality; complements individual data-analysis benchmarks.

references.title: BixBench: a Comprehensive Benchmark for LLM-based Agents in Computational Biology
references.one_liner: 围绕真实生物数据分析设置多步任务，要求智能体探索数据、完成分析，并解释结果。
references.one_liner_en: Evaluates agents on practical biological data analysis requiring exploration, multi-step computation and interpretation.
references.context: 开放回答与选择题的设置不同，阅读时应单独核对评分方式和任务版本。
references.context_en: Its open-answer and multiple-choice settings should be distinguished when examining scores and task versions.

references.title: Promptbreeder: Self-Referential Self-Improvement Via Prompt Evolution
references.one_liner: 不仅进化解题提示词，也进化用来修改提示词的提示词，让改进规则本身进入搜索过程。
references.one_liner_en: Evolves both task prompts and the mutation prompts used to improve them, bringing the improvement rule into the search.
references.context: 涉及改进机制的演化；索引不把任务成绩提升当作已证明持续自加速。
references.context_en: Evolves an improvement mechanism; task gains alone do not establish sustained self-acceleration.

references.title: Hyperagents
references.one_liner: 把解题智能体和修改智能体放进同一份可编辑程序，让负责产生改进的部分也能被修改。
references.one_liner_en: Combines task and meta agents in one editable program so that the mechanism producing improvements can also change.
references.context: 直接关注元层改进，与早期依赖固定改进流程的方法形成对照。
references.context_en: Directly concerns meta-level modification, contrasting with fixed improvement procedures.

references.title: A Self-Improving Coding Agent
authors: Maxime Robeyns, Martin Szummer, Laurence Aitchison
references.one_liner: 让编码智能体修改自己的实现，再用编程任务检查修改后的版本是否更有用。
references.one_liner_en: Lets a coding agent edit its own implementation and evaluates the resulting versions on coding tasks.
references.context: 值得进一步核对新版本如何部署，以及改进能否迁移到不同任务。
references.context_en: Further reading should check redeployment and whether improvements transfer beyond the optimization tasks.

references.title: Automated Design of Agentic Systems
authors: Shengran Hu, Cong Lu, Jeff Clune
references.one_liner: 用元智能体编写新的智能体程序，并把以前发现的设计放进档案，供后续搜索参考。
references.one_liner_en: Uses a meta agent to write new agent programs, drawing on an archive of previous designs.
references.context: 自动设计的背景工作；档案中出现更好的候选，不等于元智能体本身已经进化。
references.context_en: Background on automated design; better archived candidates do not by themselves establish an evolving meta agent.

references.title: Self-Refine: Iterative Refinement with Self-Feedback
references.one_liner: 先生成回答，再让同一个模型提出反馈并重写，重复这个过程来改善输出。
references.one_liner_en: Improves outputs by repeatedly asking the same model to generate feedback and revise its answer.
references.context: 自我反馈的背景方法，模型和修改流程保持固定，不直接证明递归自我改进。
references.context_en: Background on self-feedback, with a fixed model and revision procedure rather than demonstrated recursive improvement.

references.title: Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning
references.one_liner: 把一次任务的失败反思写进记忆，让智能体在下一次尝试时参考，而不是直接更新模型权重。
references.one_liner_en: Stores verbal reflections on task feedback in memory to guide later attempts without updating model weights.
references.context: 作为经验积累与反思机制的背景，需与改进器自身发生变化区分。
references.context_en: Background on reflection and memory, distinct from changes to the improvement mechanism itself.

references.title: STaR: Bootstrapping Reasoning With Reasoning
authors: Eric Zelikman, Yuhuai Wu, Jesse Mu, Noah D. Goodman
references.one_liner: 用模型自己生成、最终答对的推理过程继续训练模型，再用更新后的模型生成下一轮训练材料。
references.one_liner_en: Fine-tunes on successful model-generated rationales, then uses the updated model to produce another round of training data.
references.context: 生成的数据进入后续训练，但仍依赖给定问题和正确答案作为监督。
references.context_en: Generated data feeds later training, while given questions and correct answers still provide supervision.

references.title: Self-Rewarding Language Models
references.one_liner: 让模型给自己的回答打分，再迭代做偏好训练，同时观察回答能力和评分能力是否一起改善。
references.one_liner_en: Uses the model to score its own responses during iterative preference training, examining both response and judging ability.
references.context: 关注改进后的评分者能否继续提供有用反馈；自评分仍需要外部检验其可靠性。
references.context_en: Connects self-improvement with evaluation; self-produced scores still require independent reliability checks.

references.title: Self-Adapting Language Models
references.one_liner: 让模型生成用于更新自己的训练材料和更新指令，再用更新后的任务表现训练这种自编辑能力。
references.one_liner_en: Generates adaptation data and update directives, training the self-editing behavior using downstream performance after adaptation.
references.context: 连接自编辑与适应能力；并非对内部机制的完整解释，也不是持续自加速的证据。
references.context_en: Links self-editing to adaptation, without establishing complete mechanistic explanations or sustained self-acceleration.

references.title: TextGrad: Automatic "Differentiation" via Text
references.one_liner: 把语言模型写出的批评沿计算图传回各个组件，用文字建议修改提示词、代码或其他变量。
references.one_liner_en: Propagates textual feedback through a computation graph to optimize prompts, code and other variables.
references.context: 作为自动优化工具的背景，优化变量不意味着反馈模型或优化算法也在演化。
references.context_en: Background on automated optimization; changing variables does not imply an evolving optimizer or feedback model.

references.title: GEPA: Reflective Prompt Evolution Can Outperform Reinforcement Learning
references.one_liner: 读取推理、工具调用和运行结果，用自然语言总结失败原因，再提出和测试新的提示词。
references.one_liner_en: Reflects on reasoning, tool calls and outputs to diagnose failures and propose and test prompt updates.
references.context: 可观察轨迹如何指导改进的工具背景；文字反思并不自动等于忠实的内部解释。
references.context_en: A tool reference for trace-guided improvement; verbal reflection is not automatically a faithful account of internal computation.

references.title: Voyager: An Open-Ended Embodied Agent with Large Language Models
references.one_liner: 在 Minecraft 中不断尝试新任务，把写出的可执行技能存进库，供之后的探索复用。
references.one_liner_en: Explores Minecraft with an automatic curriculum and an expanding library of reusable executable skills.
references.context: 技能积累的背景工作；底层模型和技能生成流程保持固定。
references.context_en: Background on skill accumulation with a fixed underlying model and skill-generation procedure.

references.title: Mathematical discoveries from program search with large language models
references.one_liner: 让语言模型提出程序，用自动评价器筛选，再把较好的程序送回模型，逐步搜索更好的算法。
references.one_liner_en: Pairs a language model with an evaluator, feeding strong programs back into an evolutionary search for better algorithms.
references.context: FunSearch 是程序搜索背景：冻结的生成模型和固定评价器不因候选得分上升而成为递归改进器。
references.context_en: FunSearch is program-search background: better candidates do not imply that its frozen generator or fixed evaluator improves.

references.title: Absolute Zero: Reinforced Self-play Reasoning with Zero Data
references.one_liner: 由同一个模型提出代码推理任务并学习解答，用代码执行器核验任务和答案，减少对人工题库的依赖。
references.one_liner_en: Uses one model to propose and solve code-reasoning tasks, with an executor providing verifiable feedback instead of a curated task dataset.
references.context: 关注训练课程与推理能力的共同变化；外部执行器依然承担固定的验证职责。
references.context_en: Studies co-evolving tasks and reasoning, while an external executor retains the verification role.

references.title: DSPy: Compiling Declarative Language Model Calls into Self-Improving Pipelines
references.one_liner: 把语言模型调用写成可组合的模块，再通过编译器自动选择示例和优化提示，减少手工试提示词。
references.one_liner_en: Expresses language-model pipelines as composable modules and uses a compiler to optimize demonstrations and prompts.
references.context: 模块化优化的背景框架，不能仅凭标题中的 self-improving 就判定为 RSI。
references.context_en: Background on modular pipeline optimization; the title's self-improving wording alone is not evidence of RSI.

references.title: Predict Before You Modify: Learning Improvement Dynamics for Self-Evolving Agents
authors: Zixuan Xie, Chang Xu, Yuhua Jiang, Li Zhao
references.one_liner: 修改智能体前先预测修改会影响哪些任务，再用真实结果更新预测模型，让改进过程积累经验。
references.one_liner_en: Predicts task-level effects of proposed modifications, then updates the predictive model using observed outcomes.
references.context: 连接可检查的修改预测与元层改进；这里的解释来自任务级预测，并非完整神经电路解释。
references.context_en: Links inspectable modification predictions with meta-level improvement, rather than a complete neural-circuit account.

references.title: A Mathematical Framework for Transformer Circuits
references.one_liner: 用统一的数学表示拆解注意力头和残差流，说明简单 Transformer 怎样组合出具体计算。
references.one_liner_en: Develops a mathematical view of attention heads and residual streams to explain computations in simplified transformers.
references.context: 电路分析的基础工具背景，可用于比较修改前后的计算路径，不直接研究 RSI。
references.context_en: Foundational circuit-analysis background for comparing computations before and after changes; not an RSI study.

references.title: Toy Models of Superposition
references.one_liner: 用小模型研究为什么一个神经元会同时承载多个概念，解释直接按神经元读模型为什么容易误判。
references.one_liner_en: Uses toy models to study how multiple features share neurons and why neuron-level interpretation can be misleading.
references.context: 理解特征混叠的工具背景，提醒研究者不要把神经元变化直接当成单一能力变化。
references.context_en: Background on superposition, cautioning against equating a changed neuron with a single changed capability.

references.title: Towards Monosemanticity: Decomposing Language Models With Dictionary Learning
references.one_liner: 用稀疏自编码器把小模型的激活拆成更容易解释的特征，尝试绕过单个神经元语义混杂的问题。
references.one_liner_en: Uses sparse autoencoders to decompose activations into more interpretable features in a small transformer.
references.context: SAE 方法的基础背景，为模型更新前后的特征检查提供工具，论文没有闭合 RSI 循环。
references.context_en: Foundational SAE tooling for examining model changes, rather than a demonstrated RSI loop.

references.title: Towards Automated Circuit Discovery for Mechanistic Interpretability
references.one_liner: 指定一个模型行为后，自动筛选与它相关的计算连接，减少研究者手工寻找电路的工作。
references.one_liner_en: Automates the search for computational connections responsible for a specified model behavior.
references.context: 自动电路发现的工具背景，可辅助检查行为改变由哪些内部连接支撑。
references.context_en: Automated circuit-discovery tooling that can help examine internal connections supporting behavioral changes.

references.title: Attribution Patching Outperforms Automated Circuit Discovery
authors: Aaquib Syed, Can Rager, Arthur Conmy
references.one_liner: 用梯度近似估计连接的重要性，更快找到与目标行为有关的电路，并比较这种近似的局限。
references.one_liner_en: Uses a gradient-based approximation to estimate edge importance and accelerate circuit discovery.
references.context: 低成本归因的工具背景；近似归因需要另行验证，不能直接当作因果解释。
references.context_en: Lower-cost attribution tooling; approximate scores require validation before causal interpretation.

references.title: Representation Engineering: A Top-Down Approach to AI Transparency
references.one_liner: 从整组激活中寻找与诚实、无害等行为有关的表示，并尝试监测和调整这些表示。
references.one_liner_en: Studies population-level representations for monitoring and influencing high-level behaviors such as honesty and harmlessness.
references.context: 表示监测与干预的工具背景，可提出更新后的行为检查，但不自行证明改进可靠。
references.context_en: Background on representation monitoring and intervention, which can inform checks after updates without proving reliable improvement.

references.title: Steering Llama 2 via Contrastive Activation Addition
references.one_liner: 比较正反两类行为的激活差异，提取方向并在推理时加入模型，检查行为是否随之改变。
references.one_liner_en: Extracts activation directions from contrasting behaviors and adds them during inference to test behavioral steering.
references.context: 可作为内部干预的工具背景，帮助区分相关的表示与确实能影响行为的方向。
references.context_en: An intervention tool for distinguishing correlated representations from directions that influence behavior.

references.title: Discovering Latent Knowledge in Language Models Without Supervision
authors: Collin Burns, Haotian Ye, Dan Klein, Jacob Steinhardt
references.one_liner: 不直接问模型相信什么，而是从内部激活中寻找满足逻辑一致性的方向，尝试读出潜在知识。
references.one_liner_en: Looks for logically consistent directions in activations to recover latent knowledge without relying on the model's stated answer.
references.context: 用于比较模型知道什么与说出什么；探针读出的信息不自动构成真实知识的完整证明。
references.context_en: Background for comparing internal information with stated answers; probe outputs do not establish a complete account of knowledge.

references.title: Measuring Faithfulness in Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
references.one_liner: 通过改写、插入错误等方式干预思维链，观察最终答案是否跟着变，检查模型是否真的依赖写出的推理。
references.one_liner_en: Intervenes on chains of thought through edits and mistakes to test whether final answers depend on the stated reasoning.
references.context: 反思驱动改进的边界证据：写得合理的解释，未必忠实反映内部计算。
references.context_en: A boundary reference for reflection-driven improvement: plausible explanations may not faithfully describe internal computation.

references.title: Language models can explain neurons in language models
references.one_liner: 让语言模型给神经元写解释，再根据解释预测它在新文本上的激活，用预测效果检验解释。
references.one_liner_en: Uses language models to explain neurons and evaluates explanations by predicting activations on new text.
references.context: 自动解释与解释检验的工具背景，适合比较可读性和可验证性，未直接验证 RSI。
references.context_en: Background on automated explanation and testing, useful for separating readability from validity; not a direct RSI evaluation.

references.title: Refusal in Language Models Is Mediated by a Single Direction
references.one_liner: 研究拒答行为与残差流中一个方向的关系，通过干预检查这个方向是否实际影响模型的回答。
references.one_liner_en: Studies a residual-stream direction associated with refusal and uses interventions to examine its effect on model behavior.
references.context: 模型行为干预的边界证据，提醒性能变化之外还要核查安全行为是否发生改变。
references.context_en: A behavioral-intervention reference highlighting the need to examine safety changes alongside performance gains.
